description: This file defines the API and macros for the Xtensa Memory Management Unit (MMU) in the Zephyr RTOS, including memory region permissions, caching modes, and functions for MMU initialization and TLB management.

classes.name: xtensa_mmu_range
classes.description: Structure representing a memory region with name, start/end addresses, and attributes.

methods.name: xtensa_mmu_init
methods.description: Initializes the hardware MMU and sets up memory regions at boot.

methods.name: xtensa_mmu_tlb_ipi
methods.description: Sends inter-processor interrupts to flush TLBs on other processors.

methods.name: xtensa_mmu_tlb_shootdown
methods.description: Invalidates cache and flushes TLBs across processors.
